license: No standard to license: the United States has no federal invoice standard and no VAT. These are the conventions the pack writes, stated plainly. Rule wording: Apache-2.0 with this repository.
title: A US invoice with sales tax: conventions, not a standard
source: Sales tax is a state and local tax set by each jurisdiction; no federal rule prescribes an invoice's contents. Each state's tax agency, listed at usa.gov/state-taxes, sets its rates and rules. The page states each jurisdiction's tax on its own line, on Letter paper with US dates and numbers. Written 2026-10-09.

rules.text: No VAT wording; each sales tax the order lists on the page with its rate and amount; subtotal plus the taxes is the total.
